title: SCCGBench: Executability-Oriented Evaluation for Real-World Web Service-Call Code Generation
title_zh: SCCGBench：面向可执行性的真实世界网络服务调用代码生成评估

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated service-call code is increasingly important for service computing, where developers rely on large language models (LLMs) to compose services and invoke third-party services. However, current approaches have not yet evaluated the invocation and execution of services in the actual code environment. To support execution-grounded evaluation, we present the Service-Call Code Generation Benchmark (SCCGBench), a benchmark of 3,135 traceable and decontamination-filtered RapidAPI call functions from real GitHub repositories. SCCGBench uses redacted-intent generation to reduce circular leakage and introduces Mock, Robust, ParamF1, and host-, endpoint-, method-, and parameter-level diagnostics. Mock denotes a virtual-execution hit that simultaneously matches the gold host, endpoint, and HTTP method, while Robust further requires status checking and exception handling. We evaluate six code LLMs and one non-neural retrieval baseline under intent-only, retrieval-augmented, and gold-documentation Oracle settings. Results show that models often generate syntactically correct or superficially similar HTTP-request code but achieve low Mock success in the intent-only setting; the strongest evaluated model obtains only 3.76 % 3.76\% Mock. Under the gold-documentation Oracle settings (C3 and C5), Mock reaches 88.73 % 88.73\% – 90.52 % 90.52\% for the open-source models evaluated in RQ2 and 76.47 % 76.47\% – 81.86 % 81.86\% for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, whereas sparse and dense retrieval remain far below this oracle level. The findings indicate that service/API grounding is the main bottleneck: Mock is dominated by host, endpoint, and method alignment, while ParamF1 separately reveals parameter-alignment errors. SCCGBench provides an execution-grounded benchmark for Web service invocation, API recommendation, service-interface retrieval, endpoint grounding, and reliable service-call automation.
paragraphs.zh: 由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的服务调用代码在服务计算中日益重要，开发者依赖这些模型来组合服务并调用第三方服务。 然而，现有方法尚未在真实代码环境中评估服务的调用与执行过程。 为支持基于执行的评估，我们提出了服务调用代码生成基准（SCCGBench），该基准包含来自真实 GitHub 仓库的 3,135 个可追溯且经过去污染过滤的 RapidAPI 调用函数。 SCCGBench 采用意图遮蔽生成技术以减少循环泄露，并引入了 Mock、Robust、ParamF1 以及主机、端点、方法和参数级别的诊断指标。 Mock 表示虚拟执行命中，需同时匹配标准主机、端点和 HTTP 方法；而 Robust 则进一步要求状态检查和异常处理。 我们在仅意图、检索增强和标准文档 Oracle 三种设置下，评估了六种代码 LLM 和一种非神经检索基线模型。 结果表明，模型通常能生成语法正确或表面相似的 HTTP 请求代码，但在仅意图设置中 Mock 成功率较低；评估中最强的模型 Mock 成功率也仅为 3.76%。 在标准文档 Oracle 设置（C3 和 C5）下，Mock 成功率为 88.73%–90.52%（RQ2 中评估的开源模型）和 76.47%–81.86%（DeepSeek-V4-Pro），而稀疏和密集检索的结果仍远低于这一 Oracle 水平。 研究结果表明，服务/API 的落地能力是主要瓶颈：Mock 主要由主机、端点和方法的匹配度决定，而 ParamF1 则单独揭示了参数匹配错误。 SCCGBench 为 Web 服务调用、API 推荐、服务接口检索、端点落地以及可靠的服务调用自动化提供了基于执行的基准。

paragraphs.en: Service computing increasingly relies on software agents and large language models (LLMs) that can transform user intents into executable interactions with external Web services [ 1 ] . In a typical service-oriented application, a developer may ask an assistant to retrieve weather information, query financial data, translate text, or access travel services through APIs. The generated code must not only be syntactically valid; it must also select the correct service host, endpoint route, HTTP method, request headers, and query/body parameters. Therefore, service-call code generation is a service-interface grounding problem as well as a code synthesis problem.
paragraphs.zh: 服务计算越来越依赖软件智能体和大型语言模型（LLM），它们能够将用户意图转化为与外部网络服务的可执行交互 [ 1 ]。 在典型的服务导向型应用中，开发者可能会要求助手通过 API 获取天气信息、查询金融数据、翻译文本或访问旅行服务。 生成的代码不仅必须语法正确，还必须选择正确的服务主机、端点路由、HTTP 方法、请求标头以及查询/主体参数。 因此，服务调用代码生成既是服务接口落地问题，也是代码合成问题。

paragraphs.en: As a motivating example, consider the developer intent “get the current weather for a city.” The model must correctly select the host of the target service, e.g., weather-api.p.rapidapi.com , the endpoint route, e.g., /current , the HTTP method, and valid query parameters, such as the city name. Fig. 1 illustrates this grounding requirement: a service-call program is executable only when the generated request is aligned with the intended service interface rather than merely resembling plausible HTTP-request code. If either the host or the endpoint points to an incorrect target, for example by invoking another weather service or misspelling the route, the generated code fails to hit the intended interface even if it is syntactically complete and structurally plausible. In engineering terms, the entire request fails. As our experiments show (Section V ), current models most often fail exactly at this stage of selecting the right service: the vast majority of failures are caused by incorrect hosts rather than by an inability to construct requests. This highlights that evaluating service-call code generation must go beyond textual similarity and directly measure the executability of requests.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一个激励性示例，考虑开发者意图“获取某城市的当前天气”。模型必须正确选择目标服务的主机（例如 weather-api.p.rapidapi.com）、端点路由（例如 /current）、HTTP 方法以及有效的查询参数（如城市名称）。 图 1 说明了这一接地要求：只有当生成的请求与预期的服务接口一致，而不仅仅是看起来像合理的 HTTP 请求代码时，服务调用程序才可执行。 如果主机或端点指向了错误的目标，例如调用了另一个天气服务或拼写错误了路由，那么即使生成的代码在语法上完整且结构合理，也无法命中预期的接口。 从工程角度来看，整个请求都会失败。 正如我们的实验所示（第五节），当前模型最常失败的正是在选择正确服务的这一阶段：绝大多数失败是由错误的主机引起的，而非无法构造请求。 这表明，评估服务调用代码生成必须超越文本相似性，直接衡量请求的可执行性。

paragraphs.en: The community has proposed a series of benchmarks for evaluating code models. HumanEval and MBPP evaluate algorithmic correctness using standalone functions and unit tests [ 2 , 3 ] ; CrossCodeEval and CoderEval introduce cross-file context to better approximate repository-level engineering [ 4 , 5 ] ; and ComplexCodeEval further emphasizes high-star repositories, real dependencies, and timestamp-based designs to mitigate data leakage [ 6 ] . These benchmarks have made important progress in algorithmic correctness, contextual dependency, and realism. However, directly transferring them to Web service-call evaluation leaves three limitations insufficiently addressed.
paragraphs.zh: 该社区提出了一系列用于评估代码模型的基准测试。 HumanEval 和 MBPP 通过独立函数和单元测试来评估算法正确性 [ 2 , 3 ]；CrossCodeEval 和 CoderEval 引入了跨文件上下文，以更准确地模拟仓库级别的工程实践 [ 4 , 5 ]；而 ComplexCodeEval 则进一步强调高星仓库、真实依赖关系以及基于时间戳的设计，以减轻数据泄露问题 [ 6 ]。 这些基准测试在算法正确性、上下文依赖性和真实性方面取得了重要进展。 然而，若直接将其迁移到网络服务调用评估中，仍有三个局限性尚未得到充分解决。

sents.en: However, directly transferring them to Web service-call evaluation leaves three limitations insufficiently addressed.
sents.zh: 然而，若直接将其迁移到网络服务调用评估中，仍有三个局限性尚未得到充分解决。

paragraphs.en: First, tasks and metrics are misaligned with service computing. Existing benchmarks usually rely on static similarity measures such as CodeBLEU and Edit Similarity or on unit-test pass rates. Static similarity can indicate whether generated code looks like a reference implementation, but it cannot determine whether a request hits the correct service endpoint. Unit-test evaluation is also difficult to apply at scale because real Web service calls depend on credentials, network reachability, billing, rate limits, and service availability. Second, sample realism and traceability remain insufficient. Many public data sources contain automatically generated wrappers or tool-learning templates whose signatures and request structures are highly repetitive. Such samples do not reflect the diversity of in-the-wild API usage in real repositories. Third, data contamination and circular leakage remain a concern. When missing comments are completed by asking an LLM to directly transcribe code, the resulting comments may leak hosts, endpoints, parameter keys, or URL fragments, thereby turning interface grounding into answer extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，任务与指标未能与服务计算对齐。 现有的基准测试通常依赖静态相似性度量方法（如 CodeBLEU 和编辑相似性），或依赖单元测试的通过率。 静态相似性可以表明生成的代码是否与参考实现相似，但无法判断请求是否命中了正确的服务端点。 单元测试评估也难以大规模应用，因为真实的 Web 服务调用依赖于凭证、网络可达性、计费、速率限制和服务可用性。 其次，样本的真实性和可追溯性仍然不足。 许多公开数据源包含自动生成的包装器或工具学习模板，其函数签名和请求结构高度重复。 这类样本无法反映真实代码库中 API 使用的多样性。 第三，数据污染和循环泄露问题依然存在。 当通过让 LLM 直接转录代码来补全缺失的注释时，生成的注释可能会泄露主机、端点、参数键或 URL 片段，从而将接口接地问题转化为答案提取问题。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, this study presents the Service-Call Code Generation Benchmark (SCCGBench), an executability-oriented benchmark for real-world Web service-call code generation. SCCGBench mines RapidAPI call functions from real GitHub repositories and semantically aligns them with official documentation. It detects and removes template and automatically generated wrapper code, preserves complete provenance information such as repository, file URL, stars, license, and update time, and uses redacted intent generation for samples with missing comments. Specifically, before the code is given to the generation model, hosts, URLs, endpoints, and parameter keys/values are masked, and only the user goal is described in the style of real developer intents. Paired validation and group-wise ablations show no evidence that redacted intents provide an execution advantage over human comments, supporting the effectiveness of the decontamination procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，本研究提出了服务调用代码生成基准（SCCGBench），这是一个面向可执行性的、针对真实世界Web服务调用代码生成的基准。 SCCGBench从真实的GitHub仓库中挖掘RapidAPI调用函数，并将其与官方文档进行语义对齐。 它能检测并移除模板和自动生成的包装代码，保留完整的来源信息（如仓库、文件URL、星标数、许可证和更新时间），并对缺少注释的样本采用脱敏意图生成方法。 具体而言，在将代码提供给生成模型之前，主机名、URL、端点以及参数键/值会被遮蔽，仅以真实开发者意图的风格描述用户目标。 成对验证和分组消融分析表明，脱敏意图并未展现出比人类注释更具执行优势的证据，从而支持了去污染流程的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Based on SCCGBench, we conduct a systematic evaluation of one non-neural baseline and six code LLMs around three research questions. RQ1 investigates whether static similarity is consistent with real executability. RQ2 examines whether retrieval augmentation and gold documentation can overcome the bottleneck and where the bottleneck lies. RQ3 evaluates the reliability of the benchmark with respect to data contamination, temporal leakage, metric trustworthiness, and decoding diversity. The experiments yield three main findings. First, models “look right but fail to execute”: their Mock scores remain below 3.8 % 3.8\% in the intent-only setting, including a frontier reasoning-capable model evaluated in non-think mode. Second, API documentation retrieval and endpoint grounding form the core bottleneck: with gold documentation, Mock scores increase to approximately 89 89 – 90 % 90\% for most open-source models and about 82 % 82\% for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, whereas BM25 and dense retrieval still leave many correct endpoints outside the candidate set. Third, decontamination ablation, temporal slicing, human–machine agreement, decoding-diversity analysis, and bounded real-call validation jointly support the reliability of the data and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 SCCGBench，我们对一种非神经基线模型和六种代码 LLM 围绕三个研究问题进行了系统性评估。 RQ1 旨在探究静态相似性是否与实际的执行能力一致。 RQ2 考察检索增强和标准文档能否突破瓶颈，以及瓶颈具体存在于何处。 RQ3 从数据污染、时间泄露、指标可信度和解码多样性等方面评估该基准的可靠性。 实验得出了三个主要发现。 首先，模型“看似正确却无法执行”：在仅意图设置中，其 Mock 得分始终低于 3.8%（3.8\%），即便是以推理能力见长的前沿模型在非思考模式下也是如此。 其次，API 文档检索和端点定位构成了核心瓶颈：使用标准文档后，大多数开源模型的 Mock 得分提升至约 89%（89）– 90%（90\%），DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的得分约为 82%（82\%），而 BM25 和密集检索仍会将许多正确端点排除在候选集之外。 第三，去污染消融实验、时间切片、人机一致性分析、解码多样性分析以及有界真实调用验证共同证明了数据和评估的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark contribution : We propose SCCGBench, a provenance-preserving benchmark for real-world Web service-call code generation. paragraphs.en: Service computing studies the modeling, discovery, composition, management, and reliable invocation of network-accessible services. Web service invocation requires binding to a concrete service host, route, method, and parameter schema. Traditional service recommendation and mashup studies have modeled service selection through dynamic service-bundle recommendation and, more recently, multi-agent collaborative reasoning [ 7 , 8 ] . The LLM-based task studied here shifts this binding process from human-written code to model-generated code, making it closely related to Web service discovery, API recommendation, service selection, and service management.
paragraphs.zh: 服务计算研究网络可访问服务的建模、发现、组合、管理和可靠调用。 Web 服务调用需要绑定到具体的服务主机、路由、方法和参数模式。 传统的服务推荐和混合应用研究通过动态服务包推荐以及近期的多智能体协同推理来对服务选择进行建模 [7, 8]。 本文研究的基于 LLM 的任务将这一绑定过程从人类编写的代码转变为模型生成的代码，使其与 Web 服务发现、API 推荐、服务选择和服务管理密切相关。

paragraphs.en: Large code models have improved general code synthesis through pretrained and instruction-aligned representations [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . Yet service-call code generation depends on external interface knowledge: the model must identify the target host and endpoint from a large and changing API space and then construct a request that satisfies the selected interface. Recent tool/API studies, such as ToolLLM, API-Bank, RestGPT, and Gorilla, show the importance of tool selection and documentation grounding [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] ; SCCGBench further evaluates complete executable request construction at the code level.
paragraphs.zh: 大型代码模型通过预训练和指令对齐的表示方法，提升了通用代码合成能力 [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] 。 然而，服务调用代码的生成依赖于外部接口知识：模型必须从庞大且不断变化的 API 空间中识别目标主机和端点，然后构建一个满足所选接口的请求。 近期的工具/API 研究，例如 ToolLLM、API-Bank、RestGPT 和 Gorilla，表明工具选择和文档依据的重要性 [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] ；SCCGBench 则进一步在代码层面评估完整可执行请求的构建能力。

paragraphs.en: Existing code benchmarks cover algorithmic tasks, repository-level completion, and real-world issue resolution [ 2 , 3 , 21 , 4 , 5 , 22 ] . More recent work improves realism and contamination control through high-quality repositories, evolving tasks, or timestamp-based designs [ 6 , 23 ] . These benchmarks are valuable, but they rarely evaluate whether an HTTP request hits the correct external service endpoint, and they do not address circular leakage caused by LLM-completed comments that may transcribe hosts or routes.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的代码基准测试涵盖了算法任务、仓库级别的完成度以及现实世界中的问题解决 [ 2 , 3 , 21 , 4 , 5 , 22 ] 。 近期的研究通过高质量仓库、动态变化的任务或基于时间戳的设计，提升了测试的真实性和污染控制水平 [ 6 , 23 ] 。 这些基准测试很有价值，但它们很少评估 HTTP 请求是否命中了正确的外部服务端点，也没有解决由 LLM 生成的注释所导致的循环泄露问题——这类注释可能会转录主机名或路由信息。

paragraphs.en: Documentation-side acquisition. We use automated tools to crawl endpoint descriptions, parameter schemas, and response definitions from RapidAPI, and normalize the documentation metadata with reference to the OpenAPI specification. The metadata for each API includes its host, the routes of its endpoints, HTTP methods, parameter keys, and type constraints. paragraphs.en: Multi-level code-side retrieval. On the code side, we retrieve relevant repositories from GitHub [ 24 ] and locate functions that truly contain request logic through AST parsing. To balance recall and precision, we adopt a multi-level retrieval strategy from strict to loose matching : exact endpoint URL matching, route+host matching, host matching, characteristic request-header matching such as x-rapidapi-host , request-library matching such as requests/httpx , and function-definition matching. We also use service-specific features such as the *.p.rapidapi.com domain to precisely extract code snippets reflecting real application scenarios. Earlier retrieval levels provide stronger endpoint-grounding evidence, while later levels improve coverage for long-tail interfaces.

paragraphs.en: Multi-source alignment and traceability. We then semantically align service identifiers with code snippets, mapping interface definitions to real implementations. According to the strength of the alignment evidence, we annotate the documentation matching granularity (doc_match_type) as url for a complete endpoint URL match, route for route+host matching, or host_only for host-only matching. This hierarchy records the amount of grounding information available for each sample and provides a natural stratification dimension for micro-level diagnostics (Section V ). We also record repository metadata, including repository , file_url , stars, forks, license, and latest update time, making each sample traceable . Cross-repository deduplication is performed using code hashes to avoid counting the same implementation multiple times.
paragraphs.zh: 多源对齐与可追溯性。 接着，我们将服务标识符与代码片段进行语义对齐，将接口定义映射到实际实现。 根据对齐证据的强度，我们为文档匹配粒度（doc_match_type）添加注释：若完全匹配端点 URL，则标注为 url；若匹配 route+host，则标注为 route；若仅匹配 host，则标注为 host_only。 该层级结构记录了每个样本可用的落地信息量，并为微观层面的诊断提供了自然的分层维度（第五节）。 我们还记录了仓库元数据，包括仓库、文件 URL、星标数、分支数、许可证以及最后更新时间，使每个样本都具有可追溯性。 通过代码哈希进行跨仓库去重，以避免将同一实现多次计数。

paragraphs.en: (2) Decontamination of templates and wrapper code. We filter out detected template-style samples according to these signatures and follow-up audits, so the final dataset is not dominated by automatically generated wrapper data.

paragraphs.en: (3) Redacted intent generation, the core design of this work. For samples without valid comments, a naive approach is to ask an LLM to read the code and generate a comment. However, this may transcribe the request construction line by line and place answer information such as the host, endpoint, and parameters into the input, causing circular leakage. We therefore use redacted intent generation with three steps. (a) Redaction : using the ground-truth metadata g g , we replace the host, full URL, endpoint path, parameter keys/values, and keys in the code with placeholders to obtain de-identified code y ~ \tilde{y} . (b) Style-guided generation : a small number of real human comments E E are used as few-shot style anchors, and the model is asked to describe only the user goal based on y ~ \tilde{y} , such as “translate a piece of text into another language,” rather than restating implementation details. (c) Leakage checking and retry : LeakCheck ​ ( t , g ) \textsc{LeakCheck}(t,g) determines whether the generated comment t t still contains identifying tokens in g g , such as the host, endpoint path, or parameter keys. If it does, we retry once with a stricter prompt. The resulting comments are natural and close to human style, but contain no answer grounding. This preserves task semantics while substantially reducing the shortcut of reading the answer directly from the comment. Section V-C reports paired validation showing no statistically significant executability advantage for the generated intents over real human comments.

paragraphs.en: We use paired experiments to validate the non-leakage property of redacted intents. On the same set of 291 human-commented samples, we use human comments and redacted intents as inputs and compare the generated code of the strongest model. The paired permutation tests yield p = 0.68 p{=}0.68 for Mock and p = 0.65 p{=}0.65 for ES, both non-significant. As a contrast, if unredacted comments directly transcribed from the code are used, the task becomes significantly easier, with Mock 7.9 7.9 vs. 3.4 3.4 and p = 0.012 p{=}0.012 . This quantitative result supports that the redaction mechanism substantially mitigates circular leakage; details are given in Section V-C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用配对实验来验证已红黑处理意图的非泄露特性。 在相同的 291 个经人类标注的样本集上，我们将人类评论和已红黑处理的意图作为输入，并比较最强模型生成的代码。 配对置换检验得出 Mock 的 p = 0.68 p{=}0.68，ES 的 p = 0.65 p{=}0.65，两者均不显著。 相比之下，如果使用直接从代码中转录的未红黑处理评论，任务会明显更容易：Mock 为 7.9 7.9 对比 3.4 3.4，且 p = 0.012 p{=}0.012。 这一量化结果支持了以下结论：红黑处理机制显著减轻了循环泄露问题；详细信息见第 V-C 节。

paragraphs.en: All samples are packaged as standard JSON/JSONL. Each follows an “intent input–implementation output” structure and preserves multidimensional metadata, including programming language, third-party dependencies, function signature, the aligned API tuple g = ⟨ h , e , m , P ⟩ g=\langle h,e,m,P\rangle , documentation matching granularity, repository social signals (stars/forks/license/update time), and comment source. This packaging allows each sample to be used for evaluation while also supporting provenance review.

paragraphs.en: Quality and realism. Instead of relying on a single star threshold, we characterize quality using traceability, real-repository origin, and maintenance activity . The data come from 2,082 distinct repositories, with average stars and forks of 35.83 and 8.39, respectively. After removing template and automatically generated dataset-style repositories, samples are more dispersed across real application projects, and the share of any single repository is very low, preventing a small number of large repositories from dominating the dataset. We also manually audit 50 complex samples and confirm that the precise mapping between RapidAPI endpoint/parameter documentation schemas and AST-extracted code blocks reaches 96%.
paragraphs.zh: 质量与真实性。 我们不依赖单一的“星”数阈值，而是通过可追溯性、真实仓库来源以及维护活动来描述其质量。 这些数据来自 2,082 个不同的仓库，其“星”数和分叉数分别为 35.83 和 8.39。 在移除模板和自动生成的数据集风格仓库后，样本在真实应用项目中的分布更为分散，任何单个仓库所占的比例都非常低，从而避免了少数大型仓库主导整个数据集的情况。 我们还手动审计了 50 个复杂样本，并确认 RapidAPI 端点/参数文档模式与 AST 提取代码块之间的精确映射率达到 96%。

paragraphs.en: Based on SCCGBench, our experiments aim to answer the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 基于 SCCGBench，我们的实验旨在回答以下研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 : When only a natural-language intent is given, how do LLMs perform in terms of static similarity and real executability, and are the two consistent?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：当仅给出自然语言意图时，大型语言模型在静态相似性和实际可执行性方面的表现如何？这两者是否一致？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 : Can retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) [ 25 , 26 ] and gold-documentation Oracle settings improve executability? Where is the bottleneck?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：检索增强生成（RAG）[25, 26] 和黄金文档化“神谕”设置能否提升可执行性？其瓶颈何在？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 : Is SCCGBench reliable and fair with respect to data contamination, temporal leakage, automatic metric trustworthiness, and decoding diversity?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：SCCGBench 在数据污染、时间泄露、自动指标可信度和解码多样性方面是否可靠且公平？

paragraphs.en: Given a natural-language intent, and in augmented settings the provided documentation or candidates, a model must complete two steps. The first is parameter filling: supplying valid values according to parameter types and constraints. The second is executable code synthesis: generating a complete Python function with correct dependency imports, URL/header/parameter construction, a requests call, and response parsing. For standardized evaluation, all intent-only, RAG, and Oracle C3 settings share the same core prompt: the model is asked to act as an experienced Python engineer, use placeholder keys, generate only code without explanations or Markdown markers, and construct a complete request according to the available context. The prompt does not impose a fixed error-handling template in these settings. Oracle C5 is an additional robustness-oriented setting: it provides the same gold interface grounding as C3 but explicitly adds robustness constraints such as status checking and try-except exception handling. This distinction explains why C5 can substantially improve Robust after the correct endpoint has already been grounded, while C3 mainly measures whether gold documentation solves the service-interface grounding problem.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个自然语言意图，以及在增强设置中提供的文档或候选项，模型必须完成两个步骤。 第一步是参数填充：根据参数类型和约束条件提供有效的值。 第二步是可执行代码合成：生成一个完整的 Python 函数，包含正确的依赖导入、URL/标头/参数构建、requests 调用以及响应解析。 为了进行标准化评估，所有仅意图设置、RAG 设置和 Oracle C3 设置都使用相同的核心提示：模型被要求扮演经验丰富的 Python 工程师角色，使用占位符键，仅生成代码而不添加解释或 Markdown 标记，并根据可用上下文构建一个完整的请求。 在这些设置中，提示并未强制规定固定的错误处理模板。 Oracle C5 是一个额外的面向鲁棒性的设置：它与 C3 提供相同的黄金接口基准，但明确增加了鲁棒性约束，例如状态检查和 try-except 异常处理。 这种区别解释了为何在正确端点已被确定的情况下，C5 能显著提升鲁棒性，而 C3 主要衡量的是黄金文档是否解决了服务接口基准问题。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether a request hits the correct interface without relying on real networks or credentials, we implement a lightweight virtual execution environment . Given generated code y ^ \hat{y} , we first parse it into an AST and execute it in an isolated namespace. Before execution, we replace the real network libraries with fake requests and httpx modules through sys.modules injection. The fake modules intercept calls such as get/post/put/delete/patch/request , capture the target URL, HTTP method, request headers, and parameters, and return a placeholder response without issuing any real network request. From the captured request, we parse ⟨ h ^ , e ^ , m ^ , P ^ ⟩ \langle\hat{h},\hat{e},\hat{m},\hat{P}\rangle and determine Mock and Robust according to Eqs. ( 2 ) and ( 3 ). Execution is protected with timeouts and exception handling so that infinite loops or runtime errors in individual samples do not affect the overall evaluation. After execution, the original modules are restored to avoid side effects on the evaluation process. This design makes executability evaluation close to real call semantics while remaining large-scale, deterministic, reproducible, free of API quota consumption, and free of real billing.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不依赖真实网络或凭据的情况下评估请求是否命中正确的接口，我们实现了一个轻量级的虚拟执行环境。 给定生成的代码 y ^ \hat{y}，我们首先将其解析为抽象语法树（AST），并在一个隔离的作用域中执行它。 在执行之前，我们通过 sys.modules 注入将真实的网络库替换为模拟请求和 httpx 模块。 这些模拟模块会拦截 get/post/put/delete/patch/request 等调用，捕获目标 URL、HTTP 方法、请求头和参数，并返回一个占位符响应，而不会发出任何真实网络请求。 从捕获的请求中，我们解析 ⟨ h ^ , e ^ , m ^ , P ^ ⟩ \langle\hat{h},\hat{e},\hat{m},\hat{P}\rangle，并根据公式（2）和（3）确定 Mock 和 Robust。 执行过程受到超时和异常处理的保护，以确保单个样本中的无限循环或运行时错误不会影响整体评估。 执行结束后，我们会恢复原始模块，以避免对评估过程产生副作用。 这种设计使得可执行性评估既接近真实调用语义，又能保持大规模、确定性、可重复性，同时不消耗 API 配额，也不涉及实际费用。

paragraphs.en: To approximate real developer interaction, an autonomous agent faces natural-language queries whose complexity is unknown and cannot rely on prior knowledge of the target codebase. We therefore first perform macro-level aggregate evaluation over all instances to establish a strict global baseline. We then perform micro-level group diagnostics, such as by documentation matching type, comment source, and temporal slice, to reveal capability boundaries under different conditions while isolating sources of variation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了模拟真实开发者的交互，一个自主智能体需要面对复杂程度未知且无法依赖对目标代码库先验知识的自然语言查询。 因此，我们首先对所有实例进行宏观层面的聚合评估，以确立严格的全球基准线。 接着，我们进行微观层面的分组诊断，例如通过文档匹配类型、注释来源和时间切片等方式，以揭示不同条件下能力的边界，同时隔离变化来源。

paragraphs.en: We answer the three research questions on the test set of 612 612 samples. Overall, the experiments yield three mutually supporting findings. First, static similarity diverges sharply from real executability: models “look right but fail to execute,” corresponding to RQ1. Second, providing gold documentation improves executability by an order of magnitude, supporting the conclusion that API documentation retrieval and endpoint grounding are the core bottlenecks, corresponding to RQ2. Third, decontamination, temporal analysis, human–machine agreement, and decoding-diversity analysis jointly support the effectiveness of the benchmark decontamination procedure and the reliability of the metrics, corresponding to RQ3. We discuss these findings in turn.

paragraphs.en: Results. Table IV reports static similarity. Consistent with typical observations in code generation benchmarks, the BM25 retrieval baseline that copies the nearest real training code achieves the highest CodeBLEU/ES/Recall, while neural models are lower. The reasoning-capable DeepSeek-V4-Pro achieves a CodeBLEU of 25.18, second only to BM25. Notably, neural models show a high-Precision, low-Recall pattern. For example, Qwen-32B has Token Precision 66.75 and Recall 40.52, suggesting that its outputs are concise but do not fully cover the reference implementation. paragraphs.en: Observations and interpretation. Static similarity severely overestimates real usability. The executability diagnostics in Table V reveal a structural hallucination paradox: except for the 1.3B base model, most larger neural models approach near-perfect syntactic correctness, request constructability of 80 80 – 92 % 92\% , and near-perfect secret safety, but their Mock scores, which measure simultaneous host, endpoint, and method matching, are almost zero and never exceed 3.8 % 3.8\% ; host accuracies are only 3 3 – 8 % 8\% , and endpoint accuracies are only 12 12 – 19 % 19\% for these larger neural models. A sharp contrast emerges: models often write requests with the right form and high ExecReq, but they usually point to the wrong service endpoint, resulting in low Endpoint@Acc and low Mock. Even the strongest evaluated model, the reasoning-capable DeepSeek-V4-Pro in non-think mode, achieves only 3.76 % 3.76\% Mock. This result argues against attributing the failure only to weak code synthesis ability and instead indicates that the dominant failure arises from inability to ground the intent to the correct API. Moreover, although BM25 obtains the highest static similarity, its Mock remains 0 0 because it copies real code from another sample whose host often mismatches the current target or whose endpoint/method does not match even when the host is related. This further confirms the gap between “looking similar” and “being executable.”
paragraphs.zh: 观察与解读。 静态相似性严重高估了实际可用性。 表 V 中的可执行性诊断揭示了一个结构幻觉悖论：除了 1.3B 基础模型外，大多数更大的神经模型几乎达到了完美的句法正确性（请求构建能力为 80%–92%），以及近乎完美的秘密安全性，但它们的 Mock 分数（衡量主机、端点和方法的同步匹配程度）几乎为零，且从未超过 3.8%；对于这些更大的神经模型，主机准确率仅为 3%–8%，端点准确率也仅为 12%–19%。 一个鲜明对比显现出来：这些模型通常能写出形式正确且 ExecReq 较高的请求，但它们往往指向错误的服务端点，导致 Endpoint@Acc 和 Mock 分数都很低。 即使是最强的评估模型——非思考模式下的具备推理能力的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro——其 Mock 分数也仅为 3.76%。 这一结果反驳了将失败归因于较弱的代码合成能力的观点，反而表明主要失败源于无法将意图与正确的 API 关联起来。 此外，尽管 BM25 获得了最高的静态相似性，其 Mock 分数仍为 0%，因为它复制了来自另一个样本的真实代码，而该样本的主机常常与当前目标不匹配，或者即使主机相关，其端点/方法也不匹配。 这进一步证实了“看起来相似”与“可执行”之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Failure attribution. To locate where failures occur, we analyze all 3,672 3{,}672 generations from the six neural models in the intent-only setting and attribute each failure to the earliest failed stage (Table VI ). We sequentially check syntax, request construction, host, endpoint, and method, and assign each generation to the first failed stage. The results show that failures mostly occur at the earliest semantic stage of selecting the right service : host errors alone account for 69.8 % 69.8\% and are by far the dominant source of failure. In contrast, syntax errors ( 11.9 % 11.9\% ) and request-construction failures ( 13.6 % 13.6\% ) together account for only about one quarter, while endpoint or method errors after a correct host are very rare ( 2.6 % + 0.1 % 2.6\%+0.1\% ). Only a small number of generations reach a complete Mock hit; the unclassified residual cases are retained for bookkeeping and are not interpreted as a substantive failure category. In other words, model failures are rarely due to an inability to write requests; rather, the request points to the wrong service from the beginning. This is consistent with the diagnostics showing much lower host/endpoint accuracy than syntax and constructability, and provides fine-grained quantitative evidence that the bottleneck is API grounding. Even for the strongest model, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, host errors still account for about 73 % 73\% of its failures, while syntax errors account for only 2.5 % 2.5\% , further arguing against the “weak code synthesis” explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 故障归因。 为定位故障发生的位置，我们分析了意图唯一设置下六个神经模型生成的全部 3,672 个样本，并将每个故障归因于最早失败的阶段（表 VI）。 我们依次检查语法、请求构建、主机、端点和方法，并将每个生成结果归因于第一个失败阶段。 结果表明，故障主要发生在选择正确服务的早期语义阶段：仅主机错误就占到了 69.8%，是压倒性的主要故障来源。 相比之下，语法错误（11.9%）和请求构建失败（13.6%）合计仅占约四分之一，而在主机正确的情况下，端点或方法错误则极为罕见（2.6% + 0.1%）。 只有少数生成结果能完全达到 Mock 命中；未分类的剩余案例被保留用于记录，但并未被视为实质性的故障类别。 换言之，模型故障很少源于无法编写请求，而是请求从一开始就指向了错误的服务。 这与诊断结果一致：主机/端点的准确性远低于语法和可构建性，并提供了精细的量化证据，表明瓶颈在于 API 基础定位。 即使对于最强的模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，主机错误仍占其故障的约 73%，而语法错误仅占 2.5%，这进一步反驳了“弱代码合成”的解释。

paragraphs.en: Representative failure cases. To illustrate the nature of incorrect-host failures, we examine two representative failures of the strongest model, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, in the intent-only setting. In both cases, syntax and request construction succeed, but the host/endpoint points to the wrong target. Case 1: falling back to an official public API . The intent is “Get current weather for location.” The correct target is the RapidAPI wrapper open-weather13.p.rapidapi.com/city , but the model generates a call to api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather , falling back to the OpenWeatherMap public API that is familiar from pretraining rather than the target RapidAPI wrapper. A similar phenomenon occurs when an intent for retrieving video information is directed to googleapis.com/youtube/v3 . Case 2: confusing similar RapidAPI services . The intent is “Get Google trends using RapidAPI,” which explicitly mentions RapidAPI. The correct target is google-realtime-trends-data-api.p.rapidapi.com/trends , but the model calls realtime-google-trends.p.rapidapi.com , a similarly named but non-target service. These cases corroborate the statistics in Table VI : the dominant problem is not that models cannot construct requests, but that they direct requests to the wrong service, either by falling back to common public APIs or by confusing similar interfaces. This is a micro-level manifestation of the endpoint-grounding bottleneck and shows that parametric knowledge alone is insufficient for reliably locating a specific target service.

paragraphs.en: Observations and interpretation. Retrieval quality itself is limited. BM25 reaches only 33.99 % 33.99\% Endpoint@10 and 38.56 % 38.56\% Host@10, explaining why RAG raises Mock only to about 20 % 20\% : under the top-10 retrieval diagnostic, the correct endpoint is absent for roughly two thirds of samples. Dense retrieval improves Endpoint@10 to 52.45 52.45 – 54.41 % 54.41\% and average Mock to about 25.5 % 25.5\% , but the gap to Oracle C3 (Mock 86.3 % 86.3\% on average) remains about 61 points. Once gold documentation is provided, most open-source models reach about 89 89 – 90 % 90\% Mock, showing that models can generate executable requests when the correct interface is supplied. paragraphs.en: Purpose. We evaluate benchmark reliability from four perspectives: comment contamination, temporal leakage, metric trustworthiness, and decoding diversity.

sents.en: Purpose.

paragraphs.en: (1) Comment-contamination analysis. We conduct two complementary analyses. First, on the same set of 291 human-commented samples, we compare model outputs when the input is the original human comment versus when the input is the corresponding redacted intent. This matched design uses paired permutation tests. The tests yield p = 0.68 p{=}0.68 for Mock and p = 0.65 p{=}0.65 for ES, both non-significant, showing no evidence that redacted intents provide an execution advantage over real human comments. As a contrast, when unredacted code-transcription comments are used, the task becomes significantly easier, with Mock 7.9 7.9 vs. 3.4 3.4 and p = 0.012 p{=}0.012 . This contrast supports the necessity of redaction.

paragraphs.en: Second, we perform a group-wise analysis on the full test set by comment source, comparing real human comments A A with redacted intents B B . paragraphs.en: (3) Human–machine agreement. Two annotators blindly score 100 pieces of model-generated code and we compare their judgments with automatic metrics. The results are shown in Table IX . Grounding metrics such as Host/Endpoint/Method achieve human–machine Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.86 0.86 – 1.0 1.0 , indicating near-perfect agreement, and inter-annotator κ \kappa also reaches 0.88 0.88 – 1.0 1.0 . For Mock, because its definition requires host, endpoint, and method to all be correct, we combine the human judgments of these three elements as the human counterpart of Mock, yielding human–machine κ = 0.90 \kappa{=}0.90 . It is worth noting that if annotators are directly asked the broad question of whether the generated code “can run successfully,” humans tend to overestimate executability from surface cues alone: the human–machine κ \kappa is only 0.05 0.05 and the raw agreement is 0.55 0.55 , even though the two annotators are highly consistent with each other. This itself shows that humans have difficulty judging real executability by visual inspection alone, and therefore supports the necessity of execution-grounded automatic metrics. For the robustness-related error-handling judgment, human–machine agreement is moderate with κ = 0.32 \kappa=0.32 , so Robust is treated as a secondary metric.

paragraphs.en: (4) Decoding diversity (pass@ k k ). The main experiments use single greedy decoding with temperature 0 0 , where Mock approximates pass@1. To test whether a single decoding path underestimates model capability, we sample 5 outputs for each of the 612 612 test samples using Qwen2.5-Coder-7B with temperature 0.8 0.8 and compute pass@ k k using the unbiased estimator. The results are pass@1 = 0.56 % =0.56\% , pass@3 = 1.06 % =1.06\% , and pass@5 = 1.31 % =1.31\% . Although executability increases monotonically with the number of samples, the absolute value remains below 1.5 % 1.5\% , in the same order of magnitude as the 0.65 % 0.65\% under greedy decoding. This indicates that increasing sampling diversity alone cannot overcome the executability bottleneck. The root cause is failure to ground the intent to the correct interface, rather than the decoding strategy. Additional samples provide only marginal gains, consistent with the limitations of sampling-based self-consistency reasoning [ 30 ] on this task.

sents.en: Although executability increases monotonically with the number of samples, the absolute value remains below 1.5 % 1.5\% , in the same order of magnitude as the 0.65 % 0.65\% under greedy decoding.

paragraphs.en: Controlled real-call validation. To check whether virtual Mock corresponds to real reachability, we conduct a bounded safety-filtered sanity check on FREE RapidAPI services using side-effect-free GET requests. Among 75 screened services, 21 gold requests return 2xx; 19 have Mock-positive generations eligible for safe replay. Mock-positive requests return 2xx in 91.3 % 91.3\% of effective attempts (95/104; Wilson 95% CI 84.4 84.4 – 95.4 % 95.4\% ), and 16/19 APIs have at least one successful Mock-positive real call. Five of nine eligible Mock-negative requests also return 2xx because they target different but accepting endpoints on the same host, showing that Mock is stricter than a real 2xx response. This supports the positive predictive validity of Mock under reachable-service conditions but not a general equivalence to real execution.
paragraphs.zh: 受控的真实调用验证。 为了检查虚拟 Mock 是否与真实可达性对应，我们对 FREE RapidAPI 服务使用无副作用的 GET 请求进行有界安全过滤的合理性检查。 在 75 项筛选出的服务中，21 项黄金请求返回了 2xx；19 项具有 Mock 阳性生成结果，适合安全重演。 Mock 阳性请求在有效尝试的 91.3%（95/104；威尔逊 95% CI 84.4–95.4%）中返回了 2xx，并且 16/19 个 API 至少有一次成功的 Mock 阳性真实调用。 在九项符合条件的 Mock 阴性请求中，有五项也返回了 2xx，因为它们针对的是同一主机上不同但接受请求的端点，这表明 Mock 比真实的 2xx 响应更为严格。 这支持了 Mock 在可达服务条件下的正向预测有效性，但并不证明它与真实执行具有普遍等价性。

paragraphs.en: Threats to validity. Construct validity is limited because Mock/Robust use virtual execution rather than full real-network success; we mitigate this through human agreement and the bounded real-call check. Internal validity may be affected by comment-source and temporal differences; paired/group-wise contamination analyses and temporal slicing find no execution-level advantage attributable to these factors. External validity is limited to Python and the RapidAPI ecosystem; extending SCCGBench to JavaScript, other API ecosystems, and larger scales remains future work. Conclusion validity could be affected by weak retrieval or greedy decoding; dense retrievers and pass@ k k analysis show improvements but do not change the main conclusion that endpoint grounding is the bottleneck.

paragraphs.en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks in evaluating real Web service-call executability and their susceptibility to circular comment contamination by proposing SCCGBench, an executability-oriented benchmark for service-call code generation. SCCGBench consists of 3,135 decontamination-filtered and traceable RapidAPI call functions from real GitHub repositories. It uses redacted intent generation and paired validation to reduce circular leakage, and introduces execution-grounded metrics such as Mock and Robust together with a macro–micro diagnostic framework. A systematic evaluation of six code LLMs and one non-neural retrieval baseline shows that models generally “look plausible but fail to execute”: even a reasoning-capable frontier model evaluated in non-think mode achieves no more than 3.8 % 3.8\% Mock in the intent-only setting. API documentation retrieval and endpoint grounding are the core bottlenecks. Mock increases from below 4 % 4\% in the intent-only setting to about 20 % 20\% with BM25 RAG, and most open-source models reach about 89 89 – 90 % 90\% under Oracle settings, while retrieval hit rates remain limited, with BM25 Endpoint@10 at only 34 % 34\% and dense retrieval at about 54 % 54\% . Reliability analyses provide no evidence that redacted intents or older samples create an unfair execution advantage, and human–machine agreement reaches κ = 0.86 \kappa=0.86 – 0.96 0.96 for grounding metrics. SCCGBench provides an execution-grounded perspective for evaluating service invocation, API recommendation, and reliable service-call automation in service computing. Future work will investigate service-interface-specific retrieval/reranking models, joint optimization of retrieve–select–generate pipelines, and extensions to multiple programming languages and API ecosystems.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 SCCGBench——一个面向服务调用代码生成的可执行性基准，旨在解决现有基准在评估真实网络服务调用的可执行性及其对循环注释污染敏感性的局限性。 SCCGBench 包含 3,135 个经过去污染过滤且可追溯的 RapidAPI 调用函数，这些函数均源自真实的 GitHub 仓库。 该基准通过红黑化意图生成与配对验证来减少循环泄露，并引入了基于执行的指标（如 Mock 和 Robust），同时构建了一个宏观-微观诊断框架。 对六种代码 LLM 和一种非神经检索基线模型的系统性评估表明，这些模型普遍“看似合理却无法执行”：即使在非思考模式下评估的具备推理能力的顶尖模型，在仅依赖意图的设置中 Mock 得分也未能超过 3.8%（3.8\%）。 API 文档检索与端点定位是核心瓶颈。 在仅依赖意图的设置中，Mock 得分从低于 4%（4\%）提升至使用 BM25 RAG 后的约 20%（20\%），而在 Oracle 设置下，大多数开源模型可达约 89%–90%（89 – 90\%）；但检索命中率仍有限，其中 BM25 Endpoint@10 仅为 34%（34\%），密集检索也仅约 54%（54\%）。 可靠性分析未发现红黑化意图或旧样本会制造不公平的执行优势，且人机一致性在端点定位指标上达到了 κ = 0.86（\kappa=0.86）– 0.96（0.96）。 SCCGBench 为评估服务调用、API 推荐以及服务计算中可靠的服务调用自动化提供了基于执行的视角。 未来工作将研究针对特定服务接口的检索/重排序模型，联合优化“检索-选择-生成”流程，并扩展至多种编程语言和 API 生态系统。
